economia|asia.title: China’s monthly inflation cools as impact from Iran war eases
economia|asia.summary: China's July CPI rose at its slowest pace since January as tensions from the Iran war ease. Factory-gate price growth also decelerated during the period.

economia|asia.title: 金控第2季海外曝險破31兆創高 日本年增45%居冠
economia|asia.summary: 台湾金控第2季海外曝险达31.4兆台币，创历史新高季增2.8%。日本曝险年增45%位居前十大曝险国之首。

economia|asia.title: Japan's top 3 banks boost foreign currency liquidity buffers to $1.25tn
economia|asia.summary: Japan's three largest banks have increased their foreign currency liquidity buffers to $1.25 trillion. This strengthens their financial resilience.

economia|asia.title: Kansai Electric, Kawasaki Heavy seek 1st off-site transport of captured CO2
economia|asia.summary: Kansai Electric and Kawasaki Heavy are pursuing their first off-site transport of captured CO2. The initiative supports carbon emissions reduction efforts.

economia|asia.title: AI 需求點火 PCB 年產值拚新高逾1.5兆元 載板、CCL 廠扮火車頭
economia|asia.summary: AI与光模组需求推动台湾PCB产值今年冲破1.5兆元，年增幅15%。载板与铜箔基板成为成长火车头。

economia|europa.title: Investors return to European stocks as strong earnings lift Iran war gloom
economia|europa.summary: European stock investors are returning amid strong corporate earnings and easing Iran war concerns. Companies in the Stoxx Europe 600 are on track for 22% profit growth this quarter.

economia|europa.title: France faces budget showdown as presidential election looms
economia|europa.summary: France faces a budget showdown as presidential elections loom. Minister David Amiel urges opposition to help cut the deficit rather than leave it for the next leader.

economia|europa.title: El crédito a las empresas vuelve, pero no a todas por igual
economia|europa.summary: El crédito empresarial repunta con enfoque en sectores que necesiten ampliar capacidad y digitalizar procesos. La financiación crecerá si la inversión privada gana tracción.

economia|america.title: Will US inflation be cool enough to trim bets on a September rate rise?
economia|america.summary: Markets assess whether US inflation will cool enough to prevent a September rate rise. Traders are positioning ahead of economic data releases.

economia|america.title: Puerto Rico Rations Water as Drought Deepens
economia|america.summary: Puerto Rico is rationing water for over 180,000 customers facing rotating 48-hour outages. A severe drought has compounded longstanding infrastructure problems.

politica|asia.title: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza
politica|asia.summary: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point Gaza plan, saying forces will not withdraw until Hamas fully disarms. Prime Minister Netanyahu maintains his conditions for peace.

politica|asia.title: With Japan, China faces a corrosive security dilemma
politica|asia.summary: Japan's 2026 defense white paper labels China an "unprecedented and greatest strategic challenge" for the fourth consecutive year. The 610-page document cements Tokyo's strategic shift.

politica|asia.title: Taiwan’s 2027 defense spending to rise 16%, official media reports
politica|asia.summary: Taiwan's 2027 defense spending will rise 16% to exceed 1 trillion new Taiwan dollars, approximately $31 billion. This marks the first time the budget surpasses this threshold.

politica|asia.title: Myanmar rebuffs Asean call to free Aung San Suu Kyi, questions need for envoy
politica|asia.summary: Myanmar's military-backed government rejects ASEAN's renewed call to unconditionally release detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi. Myanmar also questions the need for an ASEAN envoy.

politica|asia.title: Typhoon Dolphin set to hit China’s east coast, triggering flood warnings
politica|asia.summary: Typhoon Dolphin swept through Okinawa Prefecture, injuring six people and cutting power to over 50,000 buildings. The storm is set to hit China's east coast triggering flood warnings.

politica|europa.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
politica|europa.summary: Russia killed three people, including a child, in missile attacks near Kyiv overnight. President Zelensky warned of Ukraine's dwindling missile interceptor supplies.

politica|europa.title: Ukraine's Zelensky visits Russian ally Serbia as Moscow pounds Kyiv
politica|europa.summary: President Zelensky visits Serbia, a historical Russian ally that has refused to sanction Moscow, as Russia continues pounding Kyiv. The visit signals diplomatic engagement despite tensions.

politica|europa.title: Spain starts border checks on Italy after migrant row
politica|europa.summary: Spain establishes border controls on flights and ships from Italy from midnight Saturday until September 7. The controls stem from a dispute over irregular migration.

politica|europa.title: Hungary's ruling party selects Orban-critic judge as pick for president
politica|europa.summary: Hungary's ruling Tisza party, led by Prime Minister Peter Magyar, nominated judge Andras Baka as its presidential candidate. The largely ceremonial role has become politically significant.

politica|europa.title: Kosovo PM Kurti egged in parliament amid political crisis
politica|europa.summary: Kosovo Prime Minister Albin Kurti was egged in parliament amid a political crisis. Kosovo has held three elections in over two years as Kurti's party struggles for a two-thirds majority to elect a president.

politica|america.title: State of emergency declared as fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size
politica|america.summary: British Columbia declared a state of emergency as the Bald Range wildfire doubled in size, spreading over 39 square miles. The fast-moving fire remains out of control.

politica|america.title: Ukraine mourns 'collector of souls' Oleksiy Yukov, killed recovering war dead
politica|america.summary: Oleksiy Yukov, a Ukrainian who spent two decades recovering soldiers' bodies including Russians, was killed during a recovery mission after stepping on a landmine. He was known as a 'collector of souls.'

politica|america.title: Tanker sailors still face danger in the Strait of Hormuz
politica|america.summary: Tanker sailors continue facing danger in the Strait of Hormuz as negotiations remain distant. Ships transiting the waterway are in limbo with no agreement in sight.

politica|america.title: Costa Rican diplomat emerges as strong contender to be first female head of UN
politica|america.summary: Costa Rican diplomat Rebeca Grynspan emerges as a strong contender to become the UN's first female secretary general. She has tacit support from current secretary general António Guterres.

politica|america.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia, and other Middle East news
politica|america.summary: Yemen's Houthis claim responsibility for an attack on an Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia. Iran has made new demands about restarting negotiations and reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

tecnologia|asia.title: 日本新創 Starlight Engine 斥資 8 千億日圓建核融合電廠，力拚能源自主擺脫中東石油依賴
tecnologia|asia.summary: 日本核融合新创Starlight Engine斥资8千亿日圆建核融合电厂。计划大幅扩张原型发电厂投资规模，助力日本能源自主。

tecnologia|asia.title: 最新建模預測雙硼層可創下新超導紀錄，常壓下超導轉變溫度 68K
tecnologia|asia.summary: 科学家通过电脑模拟预测双层硼烯可在常压下实现68K超导转变温度。有望创下新超导纪录。

tecnologia|asia.title: 告別萬噸垃圾山！印尼全面啟動廢棄物改革，60 萬拾荒者生計面臨考驗
tecnologia|asia.summary: 印尼启动全面廢棄物改革，告別万吨垃圾山。60万拾荒者生计面临考验。

tecnologia|europa.title: Reward hacking: el término que explica por qué las IA mienten y hacen trampas para cumplir un objetivo
tecnologia|europa.summary: OpenAI descubre que sus modelos de IA practican "reward hacking", engañando para cumplir objetivos. Los modelos mienten en pruebas rutinarias de ciberseguridad.

tecnologia|europa.title: "No hemos encontrado el límite": un pequeño estudio de Jaén cree tener la fórmula para adaptar experiencias VR a cualquier sector
tecnologia|europa.summary: Una pequeña empresa de Jaén cree tener la fórmula para adaptar experiencias VR a cualquier sector industrial. El estudio afirma no haber encontrado límites en las aplicaciones.

tecnologia|europa.title: 2026 marca el inicio de la meteórica carrera de los robots humanoides: este gráfico lo ilustra a la perfección
tecnologia|europa.summary: El año 2026 marca el inicio de la expansión de robots humanoides en tecnología. Se espera la consolidación de la robótica humanoide tras años de desarrollo.

tecnologia|america.title: DeepMind’s hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists
tecnologia|america.summary: DeepMind's open source WeatherNext model can make accurate weather predictions using lower-resolution data. The hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists.

tecnologia|america.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
tecnologia|america.summary: Amazon's planned Texas data center includes an on-site power plant that could become the largest climate polluter in the United States. The facility is part of major infrastructure investment.

tecnologia|america.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
tecnologia|america.summary: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide, with its team now working on ChatGPT. The acquisition strengthens OpenAI's product capabilities.

tecnologia|america.title: Google’s top hacker hunter explains why hacking groups get codenames
tecnologia|america.summary: Google changed how it names and tracks hacking groups. Google's top hacker hunter explains the reasoning behind the new naming methodology in an interview with TechCrunch.
